notes: D1 oracle is docs/south-yorkshire-d1/oracle-clash-report.md only. No product lib/cities/south-yorkshire/ exists yet. Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file. No UK-country ledger exists yet (docs/*-ledger.md glob has only denmark-ledger.md) — this pack proceeds without one, same basis as East Midlands.

Two agencies, two direction models, one shared hub name (Sheffield Station) with doNotGroup between the layers, plus a second non-hub through-running/infrastructure-switch point at Meadowhall Interchange. See direction-model-memo.md and hazard-pack.md H1/H6.

Supertram modes v1: TRAIN-like light rail only (tram + tram-train). Four lines: Blue, Purple, Yellow, Tram-Train. 51 stops total per the report, but this pack does not enumerate all 51 — only the named termini/via-points/hub stations from the report. See coverageGaps.

Supertram real-time: SCHEDULE-ONLY v1, source TBD. This is a genuine operator-transition skip risk (SYFTL took over from Stagecoach 22 Mar 2024, no confirmed GTFS under the new operator), distinct in kind from the National Rail account block below — do not conflate the two in downstream QA notes.

National Rail modes v1: heavy rail, destination-board model (not line+terminus). BLOCKED pending DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN — see coverageGaps. Build the catalog/adapter normally per Nico's report; do not wire the token until it exists.

Hub lock: Sheffield Station (SHF CRS). Supertram tram viaduct above National Rail main platforms, footbridge connects. doNotGroup Supertram tram vs National Rail at this station — separate infrastructure, separate operators, separate boarding areas.

Meadowhall Interchange (MHS CRS) is a through-running/infrastructure-switch point, NOT a second hub lock: Supertram Tram-Train switches onto National Rail infrastructure here to continue to Rotherham Central and Parkgate. Shared platform area but separate operators/infrastructure (doNotGroup applies but it is not modelled as a parent hub the way Sheffield Station is).

Rotherham Central: National Rail only at this point in National Rail's own network sense per the report, but Tram-Train (Supertram) also terminates a segment here before continuing to Parkgate — through-running only, no shared platform with National Rail main-line trains per the report (line 17).
Parkgate is a Tram-Train-only terminus, not served by National Rail.

Denby Dale, Darton, South Elmsall, Moorthorpe are National Rail-only boundary stations with West Yorkshire, on the ticketing-scheme boundary. They may appear in both South Yorkshire and West Yorkshire feeds if both regions ship National Rail slices — flagged as a D2 de-dup boundary, not resolved here.

Chesterfield is East Midlands' station, not South Yorkshire's, per the oracle report (line 42) and per docs/east-midlands-d1/published-network.json (already lists Chesterfield under East Midlands' throughRunningOnly). NOT included in this pack's station list, to avoid two regions independently owning the same catalog entry.

City lands as 'Coming Soon' (status stays planned; there is no separate coming-soon enum value in registry.js) until National Rail is unblocked AND Supertram's real-data-source question is resolved with SYFTL/SYMCA, same overall status shape as West Midlands / Greater Manchester / Liverpool City Region / East Midlands.

Supertram line station arrays below are TERMINI + NAMED VIA-POINTS + hub only, as given by the report's line descriptions (line 39) — NOT a full ordered intermediate stop list (51 stops total, only a subset named). This is a real gap; see coverageGaps and hazard-pack.md H3/H4/H5.
gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown is left empty for all four Supertram lines — no GTFS route_id exists because no confirmed feed exists at all under SYFTL. Do not guess it.

printedInnerCityNames.note: Two locks sharing one printed name, one building (viaduct above main platforms, footbridge connects), doNotGroup between them. See hazard-pack.md H1/H6. Meadowhall Interchange (MHS CRS) is a separate, non-hub through-running point — see meadowhall notes below, do not conflate with the Sheffield Station hub lock.

coverageGaps: Supertram real-time: NO confirmed feed at all under the new operator (SYFTL, since 22 Mar 2024). This is a genuine operator-transition skip risk, not the standard account-registration block — no public GTFS or GTFS-RT found; previous Stagecoach TransXChange/NetEx terms may not carry over. Confirm data export/GTFS publication plans with SYFTL/SYMCA before this can move past schedule-only v1. Live departures board (livetrams.azurewebsites.net) has no documented API and is not usable as a machine-readable source.

Supertram licensing: license confidence `unclear` per the oracle report. Previous Stagecoach data was described as open for personal/educational/commercial use, but SYFTL/SYMCA has not published explicit terms in sources checked. Do NOT assume open redistribution; confirm with SYFTL before D1 build proceeds past this catalog.

National Rail real-time: OpenLDBWS documented and technically live, but BLOCKED at the account level (AU-registered RDM account; Tim re-registering with UK address). Not a feed problem. Do not wire DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN until it exists. Same blocker as East Midlands / West Midlands / Greater Manchester / Liverpool City Region — already accepted, not re-flagged as a new blocker.

National Rail licensing: OGL 2.0 baseline permits redistribution with attribution, but the RDM Platform Agreement's language on downstream redistribution to third-party rider clients is UNCLEAR in public sources. Confidence: unclear (per oracle report License section). OPEN ITEM FOR TIM ONLY — do not resolve here; do not assume permission to relay Darwin data to end users until Tim confirms against the signed RDM Data Sharing Agreement. Same open item already raised for East Midlands.

Supertram's four lines' full intermediate stop order (51 stops total) is not in the oracle report — only named termini/via-points. Do not treat the 'stations' arrays below as complete; pull a confirmed GTFS feed (once one exists under SYFTL) for the real ordered list.
Purple line's Gleadless Townend branch junction detail is not in the oracle report — flagged in direction-model-memo.md, not resolved here.

National Rail has no printed route/line map to transcribe (Darwin is a real-time per-station board product) — no 'lines' array is provided for National Rail in this pack, only the hub, Meadowhall through-running/switch point, and boundary station list. See direction-model-memo.md for the destination+operator model recommended instead of line+terminus.
Denby Dale / Darton / South Elmsall / Moorthorpe boundary de-dup with West Yorkshire is explicitly out of scope for this pack — D2 concern for a future West Yorkshire pack.
Chesterfield is intentionally excluded from this pack's station list — it is East Midlands' station per that pack's published-network.json; see notes above.
No buses, no other rail modes, no Supertram real-time in v1 scope, per the oracle report.
